description: Image Description: The image features a close-up view of a standard three-light traffic signal mounted on a horizontal metal pole against a clear blue sky. The traffic light is yellow in color and consists of three circular lenses arranged vertically: red at the top, amber (yellow) in the middle, and green at the bottom. The red light is illuminated, indicating a stop signal. The housing of the traffic signal is metallic with visible bolts and structural supports. The backside of the signal is partially visible,
